direction_cn: 按州/领地的第一步安全导航
current_evidence: ABS shows national scale and state/territory differences; system map shows legal and service pathways differ by jurisdiction.
data_still_needed: More detailed official pathway audit for each state/territory; user testing on whether state selection feels safe and understandable.
recommended_action: Build first as the core product architecture.

direction_cn: 中文/CALD 双语安全导航
current_evidence: ABS supports the general violence problem; government and service systems are complex; multilingual/cultural barriers are plausible and supported by adjacent research direction.
data_still_needed: ANROWS/eSafety CALD evidence; audit of Chinese-language services; interviews with Chinese-speaking users and community workers.
recommended_action: Validate next; likely strong if service accessibility gap is confirmed.

direction_cn: 技术促成虐待/手机账号定位安全
current_evidence: ABS includes stalking, harassment, emotional/economic abuse signals; product research suggests phone/account/location concerns may be a first-search trigger.
data_still_needed: eSafety/ANROWS/WESNET evidence; support worker interviews; safety review for what users should and should not check on devices.
recommended_action: Validate next; design must be privacy-first and no-login.

current_evidence: Existing services often focus on the person experiencing violence; bystanders may need low-risk scripts and referral guidance.
data_still_needed: Bystander resource audit; interviews with support workers; usability testing with friends/peers/classmates.
recommended_action: Consider as a core secondary entry point.

current_evidence: Users may need reassurance and examples, but current ABS data cannot prove demand for peer stories.
data_still_needed: Safety review; moderation model; content governance; testing whether stories reduce confusion without increasing risk.
recommended_action: Test as a safer alternative to public forum.

current_evidence: ABS shows boyfriend/girlfriend/date violence exists in national findings, but not dating-app-specific motivations.
data_still_needed: AIC dating app research; dating platform safety audit; interviews with young adults/international students.
recommended_action: Keep as a research stream, not first core build.

direction_cn: 国际学生关系与安全支持
current_evidence: Problem is plausible because of visa, housing, school and family concerns, but ABS does not directly isolate this group.
data_still_needed: University support pathway audit; international student interviews; student association and wellbeing staff interviews.
recommended_action: Research further; may combine with Chinese/CALD or dating safety.

current_evidence: ABS does not support this as a need; prior safety analysis shows high identity exposure, misinformation, monitoring and moderation risks.
data_still_needed: Only consider after expert safety review, moderation plan, and strong evidence that safer alternatives are insufficient.
